g.text: Transitivity: observed draw minus its control
Controls are rebuilt from each observed draw, so they hold information no LLM or fixed baseline had. Ticks are sampling variation of overlapping
draws, not confidence intervals; no test is implied.
Same node and edge count, edges placed at random
Same degree of every node (edge swaps)
